title: no cutscene camera enhanced ver
features:
attempts to remove cutscenes or camera movements during certain battleground game moves (currently probably works on jun [lbg] only but im not sure)

use the old version here! https://scriptblox.com/script/Universal-Script-no-cutscene-camera-60399
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CameraType"):Connect(function()
	if camera.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Follow then
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Follow
	end
end)

local liveFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("Live")

local function setupPlayerFolder(folder)
	if folder.Name ~= player.Name then return end

	local bind = folder:FindFirstChild("CutsceneCameraBind")
	if bind then bind:Destroy() end

	folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child.Name == "CutsceneCameraBind" then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

for _, folder in ipairs(liveFolder:GetChildren()) do
	setupPlayerFolder(folder)
end

liveFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(setupPlayerFolder)
